morbi.headline: Morbi ceramic exports plunge due to Iran conflict amid rising propane and infrastructure pressures.
what_changed: Ceramic exports dropped by Rs 3,589 crore over six months due to the Iran war.
Industrial propane gas prices rose by Rs 3 to reach Rs 104 per kg.
Kajaria Ceramics acquired a 19.77% stake in Sunsure Solar Park Twenty One for ₹1.21 crore.
stress_signals: Iran war impacts led to a massive Rs 3,589 crore drop in ceramic exports [19f71f3185bc].
Escalating propane prices (up by Rs 3 to Rs 104/kg) cloud tile makers' recovery [3d9aa30057b8, 9e8c549b7c05].
Overall export outlook remains weak despite shipments to the Gulf resuming [c2b4a2f5422a].
improvement_signals: Propane usage has resumed in the Morbi ceramic cluster [3d9aa30057b8].
Ceramic shipments from Morbi to the Gulf have resumed [c2b4a2f5422a].
Kajaria Ceramics invested ₹1.21 crore in a solar energy stake [a2787358932e].
what_to_watch: Monitor working capital utilization and debt servicing for export-oriented units facing revenue contractions.
Track further movements in industrial propane and gas input prices impacting operating margins.
Assess resolution of local infrastructure, power, and water representations submitted to the district minister.

surat.headline: Surat faces severe MMF textile payment stress despite festive diamond and export wins.
what_changed: Weavers in Sayan zone announced a collective vacation cutting fabric production by 60 crore meters to address ongoing financial distress.
Textile trade credit extended past 200 days, triggering widespread labor and trade payment disputes reaching police involvement.
Lab-grown diamond demand surged ahead of Diwali, leading to 10% worker bonuses and factories extending operations until Dhanteras.
Government halved the PLI scheme turnover threshold for textiles and extended its duration through FY 2033-34.
stress_signals: Payment dues to weavers have crossed 200 days, leading to protests, widespread trader defaults, and mounting payment blockages across the supply chain [774ba602b06e, e0787797133b].

Organized fraud gangs and defaulted buyers caused multiple payment failures, including ₹1.5 crore owed to jobworkers and ₹22 lakh defrauded by regional traders [421d4bf835f5, 6a3068dc8bf1, f699b1f05b5e].
100,000 job losses reported in the diamond manufacturing sector amidst ongoing downturn [1bcd949a2599].
Rising trade friction and payment recovery disputes between weavers and traders led to police station interventions [80f44f3f370f, 9a8429b49c99].
improvement_signals: Lab-grown diamond units report increased Diwali demand, offering 10% bonuses to workers and operating through Dhanteras [751cd1661531, e533595d0815].
Embroidery sector labor dispute ended successfully after an agreement between unit owners and labor organizations [3a495ae0b3ee].
SGCCI signed two MoUs in Morocco to expand Surat textile export channels [472a28abf217].
what_to_watch: Monitoring working capital cycle over-runs and receivables aging beyond 180 days for weaver and job-work borrower accounts.
Utilisation levels of CC/OD limits in Sayan weaving units due to the planned 60 crore meter production cut.
Implementation guidelines for the revised lower-threshold Textile PLI scheme to identify eligible MSME borrowers for capex financing.
Potential operational shutdowns or labor agitation recurrence in textile units following August unrest risks.
